title: Xtra Power Heavy-Duty Caulking Gun CG 205, Steel Body with Ergonomic Grip, Nickel-Plated Barrel
description: The XTRA POWER Caulking Gun CG 205 is a heavy-duty tool built for professionals and DIY enthusiasts alike. Constructed with a robust steel body, this caulking gun is designed to withstand the rigours of demanding projects, whether you are sealing windows, filling gaps, or applying adhesives. The nickel-plated barrel resists corrosion and rust, ensuring long-lasting performance even with regular use. The ergonomically designed handle provides a comfortable grip, reducing hand fatigue during extended applications. A flexible trigger mechanism allows for smooth, consistent flow of caulking material, enabling clean and precise application every time. The dual air valves help control the flow efficiently, minimising wastage and mess. Compatible with a wide variety of standard caulking cartridges, this gun is a versatile addition to any toolkit. Whether you are a seasoned contractor or a first-time user, the XTRA POWER CG 205 delivers reliable performance and ease of use on every job.
Name: Xtra Power Heavy-Duty Caulking Gun CG 205, Steel Body with Ergonomic Grip, Nickel-Plated Barrel
